question: Ram has a corrective lens of power -6.5 D. The focal length of the lens is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**-15.38 cm**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The power of a lens (measured in diopters, D) is the reciprocal of its focal length (measured in meters, m). The formula is: 
 
• Power (D) = 1 / Focal Length (m) 
 
• Important Note about Sign Conventions:
 
• Negative Power: A negative lens power indicates a diverging lens (also called a concave lens). Diverging lenses are used to correct nearsightedness (myopia). 
 
• Positive Power: A positive lens power indicates a converging lens (also called a convex lens). Converging lenses are used to correct farsightedness (hyperopia). 
 
• Calculation
 
• Given: Power = -6.5 D
 
• Formula: Focal Length (m) = 1 / Power (D)
 
• Calculation: Focal Length = 1 / -6.5 D = -0.1538 m = -15.38 cm
